review.rationale: Option A correctly bounds the next step to factual reconciliation of the five canonical commercialization status surfaces and preparation of the CE-G12 Recommendation as a decision-input artifact only. It accurately reflects the direct evidence: PR #27 is merged, post-merge validation passed, and the External Agent First Run has already succeeded (4/4 sessions, 2 providers, 0 boundary failures), making repetition redundant absent a new contract. All authority, release, deployment, standard, production, and commercial boundaries are explicitly preserved as false, and no execution is authorized. The five-path scope is sound, stop conditions and validation contract are well-defined, and the separation between Recommendation, Decision, and Execution is maintained.
